prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: fetch-highword
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): ff4f3b3cfe222e0e
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Fetch makes no progress (max_addr 0x00000000, FAIL 0xdead after 2009 cycles). In mem_state 0 mem_valid is assigned mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word instead of its complement, so normal fetches never assert mem_valid while prefetched-high-word hits spuriously request. The state-1 assert mem_valid == !mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word confirms the inversion, explaining the stall.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash ff4f3b3cfe222e0e in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
